notes: In the first isnad «يخبر ابن عمر» addresses Ibn Umar in the scene, so he is not a link there (rule 6); the second isnad has him as a link.
The text ends after a «ح» whose branch is not written; nothing is added for it.
«- وهو القطان -» is a gloss and is left out; «عبيد، الله» keeps its comma as written.
